Martin, transfert sanguin et mort de Smiley : une chaîne causale complète
Menace de la boîte à musique puis résolution par Boyd, sans laisser la crise ouverte
Grossesse, retour de Smiley et témoignage sur le sacrifice

duration_note: Estimation au débit réel de la première génération, puis fourchette 106–123 mots/minute. Le MP3 régénéré devra être mesuré pour confirmer 2h minimum et 2h30 maximum.
editorial_notes: La progression reste défense nocturne, menace intérieure, retour des créatures, danger diurne puis sabotage des protections. Le chapitre 16 est gardé expressément pour résoudre la boîte à musique introduite au 15. Les lances et Roger sont retirés ensemble pour éviter une référence sans présentation. Aucun mot nouveau dans le script.

Répétition du pouvoir de persuasion des voix

before_last_two_sentences: The town has therefore gone beyond telling people that the creatures are dangerous.
Its precautions account for people being tired, distracted, frightened, or too young to carry the whole burden of keeping a household safe.
after_first_two_sentences: Meagan's window answers the first practical question FROM puts before us.
A house with a talisman can be entered when someone inside opens it to a creature.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord interne direct : les précautions physiques mènent à la leçon de la fenêtre. Retirer la punition de Frank ne laisse aucune conséquence annoncée sans résolution.

before_last_two_sentences: By the end of the opening, Boyd's bell and the secured windows have become understandable parts of ordinary life here.
Another household hearing that evening warning has a specific task to complete: get everyone inside, close the house, and make sure a child can't reopen a window on her own.
after_first_two_sentences: Boyd finds the talismans while taking shelter in a small stone hollow in the woods.
By then, darkness has caught him away from the town, and the creatures are approaching.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord de retour en arrière autonome : le texte nomme Boyd et sa découverte des talismans, sans s’appuyer sur le chapitre supprimé des nuits avant les pierres.

before_last_two_sentences: For the surviving residents, maintaining shelter now includes a problem the talisman can't settle for them.
Everyone inside has to leave the boundary intact, including when someone outside has made breaking it feel personal.
after_first_two_sentences: Boyd can hear a man above him while he's trapped at the bottom of the shaft.
The man says his name is Martin, and a rope gives Boyd a way to climb out.
join_reviews.judgment: Changement de type de danger explicite : la frontière d’un foyer se conclut ; la scène suivante situe Boyd dans le puits, présente Martin et décrit la transmission. Le passé de la scène est expliqué dans le chapitre gardé.

before_last_two_sentences: The result is substantial enough without turning it into a weapon the residents can already reproduce.
For now, Ellis receives treatment, Boyd has survived the contact, and Smiley's body lies available for investigation.
after_first_two_sentences: Kenny wakes from a dream with a burn on his arm.
While he's asleep, a telephone rings, a voice recites a disturbing nursery rhyme, and something that should belong to the dream reaches his body.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord cohérent : Smiley est mort, puis une blessure de sommeil ouvre la menace suivante. Le chapitre relie lui-même les cicadas aux restes de Smiley et le 16 résout la crise.

before_last_two_sentences: Marielle, meanwhile, resumes caring for people at the clinic alongside Kristi.
The series doesn't give her an identical version of Julie's encounters or Randall's recurring cicadas.
after_first_two_sentences: Fatima can't eat the food that's supposed to nourish her.
As her apparent pregnancy continues, ordinary meals become difficult to keep down, while spoiled vegetables begin to appeal to her.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord cohérent : réveil et séquelles des trois captifs ferment la boîte à musique ; la grossesse ouvre un autre cas autonome, avec Fatima et son contexte présentés.

before_last_two_sentences: Among the children was their daughter.
They have found their way back to the place where they lost her, and this time they can remember who they've been trying to reach.
after_first_two_sentences: Jim meets the Man in Yellow in daylight, near the wrecked RV that brought the Matthews family into the town's first night.
The man doesn't need darkness to approach him, and Jim has no house or closed door between them.
join_reviews.judgment: Changement de scène compréhensible : la révélation des enfants se clôt ; Jim, le RV, la lumière du jour et l’adversaire sont explicitement introduits. L’enjeu devient la limite du jour protecteur.

before_last_two_sentences: With Sophia's identity revealed, the audience also knows he doesn't always arrive wearing the clothes Jim saw.
The town's daylight hours now include a danger that can meet people with another face.
after_first_two_sentences: The bottle tree is uprooted, and the sky darkens while the residents are still in what had been daytime.
In the season four finale, that change brings the creatures into hours the town has depended on for work outside.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord nettoyé : l’amorce de Sophia/prêtre/Henry a été retirée avec la scène de Henry. La conclusion restante concerne la menace diurne, puis la finale introduit la perte collective du jour.

before_last_two_sentences: That leaves Ellis with a wife whose actions he can recognize even as her condition has become frighteningly unfamiliar.
Jade and Tabitha get away with help from Fatima, and Fatima remains behind.
after_first_two_sentences: Sophia takes the talismans away while the town's attention is elsewhere.
Clara helps her remove the protections, and Sophia disposes of the stones through a faraway tree.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord parallèle cohérent : le sauvetage et le sort non résolu de Fatima sont posés, puis Sophia est nommée comme actrice d’un sabotage distinct. Pas de confusion entre secours et vol des talismans.
